title: Relations satisfied by the shifted highest-root vector in the level-one Demazure module D(1,(k+1)theta)
author: Bhimarthi Ravinder
work: Demazure Modules, Chari-Venkatesh Modules and Fusion Products
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the technical core used later to build the map phi^- of the article's main theorem: it asserts three relations for the single shifted vector (x^-_theta (x) t^{2k+1-i}) wbar in D(1,(k+1)theta). Part (1) needs the weight computation, the annihilation by x^+_alpha (x) 1 through the root theta - alpha, and the standard sl_2 argument (source lines 469-476); part (2) requires specialising Garland's current-algebra identity to r = 2, s = 3k+1-i, alpha = theta, recognising that the resulting double sum can be grouped modulo the submodule generated by (x^-_theta (x) t^{2k+2-i}) wbar, and then acting by x^+_{theta-alpha} to convert the expansion into the claimed vanishing (lines 477-491). Neither the grouping of the Garland sum nor the use of the shifted vector's vanishing relations is a routine verification from the defining relations, and part (3) depends on a separate relation proved earlier in the article (line 492).
